    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AnimationCharacter
    The AnimationCharacter class provides methods to add animation effects to JavaFX UI components such as StackPane and ImageView.
    AnimationEight
    The AnimationEight class provides animation effects for UI elements in a JavaFX application.
    AnimationGame
    Handles various animations for the game, such as card interactions, hover effects, and transitions.
    AnimationMenu
    Handles various animations for the main menu, such as title scaling, button hover effects, and menu transition animations.
    AnimationScoring
    The AnimationScoring class provides utility methods for applying various animation effects to JavaFX UI components, such as fade-in and fade-out transitions and button hover animations.
    AnimationSetting
    The AnimationSetting class provides animations for UI components related to settings, including fade transitions and hover effects.
    App
    The main entry point for the Crazy Eights game application.
    Card
    Represents a playing card with a suit and rank.
    CardObserver
    The CardObserver interface defines the contract for observing changes related to a Card object.
    CharacterChooseView
    The CharacterChooseView class is responsible for creating and managing a character selection interface in a JavaFX application.
    Chat
    Represents a chat system that manages messages and notifies the game controller when a new message is added.
    ChatObserver
    An interface representing an observer in the observer design pattern specifically for a chat system.
    ChooseEightView
    The ChooseEightView class is responsible for managing and displaying a selection of "eight" playing cards with animations and styles in a JavaFX application.
    CPU_Msg
    The CPU_Msg class provides a collection of predefined messages for CPU interactions in a game, supporting both English and Korean languages.
    Deck
    Represents a deck of cards used in a single-play game.
    DeckObserver
    DeckObserver is an interface used to observe changes or updates in a deck of cards or any related observable entity.
    DummyCard
    The DummyCard class serves as a placeholder or proxy for a Card object, maintaining an association with an Image, a Card, a CardObserver, and a SinglePlayGameController.
    GameStatusManager
    GameStatusManager is a class responsible for managing the state of the game, including turn tracking, timing, and various statuses such as user actions, turn passing, and game effects.
    Generator
    The Generator class serves as an entry point to launch the JavaFX application.
    Log
    The Log class is responsible for managing a list of log messages and notifying a game controller whenever a new log entry is added.
    LogObserver
    The LogObserver interface defines the contract for objects that observe and respond to log updates.
    MenuController
    The MenuController class manages the main menu of the application.
    MenuView
    Represents the main menu of the Crazy Eights game.
    Music
    The Music class is responsible for managing background music in the application.
    Player
    Represents a player in a card game.
    PlayerHandView
    The PlayerHandView class is responsible for visualizing the cards in a player's hand within the game interface.
    PlayerObserver
    The PlayerObserver interface represents an observer in the observer design pattern for tracking changes in a Player object.
    PlayerScoreView
    The PlayerScoreView class represents the visual component responsible for displaying a player's score and icon in the game.
    PlayerStatusView
    The PlayerStatusView class represents a UI component responsible for displaying and updating the status of a player in a game.
    ScoringView
    The ScoringView class is responsible for creating and managing the scoring view in a JavaFX-based application.
    Setting
    The Setting class manages the state of two static boolean flags, `enClicked` and `krClicked`, used to represent some settings or toggle states.
    SettingView
    The SettingView class is responsible for displaying and managing the settings interface for the application.
    SinglePlayGameController
    The SinglePlayGameController class handles the main logic and state of a single-player game.
    SinglePlayGameView
    The SinglePlayGameView class represents the user interface for a single-player game mode.
    State
    Represents the various states that can be associated with log messages or system events.
    StyleCharacter
    Provides styling configurations for specific character-related UI components.
    StyleEight
    Provides styling configurations for various UI components.
    StyleGame
    Provides styling configurations for the game application.
    StyleMenu
    Provides styling configurations for the main menu components.
    StyleScoring
    Provides various CSS style configurations for theming UI components.
    StyleSetting
    Provides styling configurations for the application.
